Terms & Hyperlocal Policies

1. Zero Platform Commission: Under the GaonBazaar Rural Growth Initiative, 0% platform commission applies on all genuine grocery orders.

2. 8km Geofenced Service: Orders are routed exclusively to shops located within 8km radius of village customers to assure 20-30 min delivery.

3. Settlement & Payouts: Daily UPI / IMPS payouts with automated ₹1 penny drop beneficiary verification.
